newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yaohan Japan unit to sell shops to Best Denki unit.
newsitem.headline: Yaohan Japan unit to sell shops to Best Denki unit.

text.p: Yaohan Japan Corp said on Monday it had agreed with Best Denki Co Ltd that its unit would sell nine electrical appliance stores to Best Denki's subsidiary for 2.28 billion yen.
The nine shops are currently operated by Yaohan Best as Best Denki franchises, Yaohan Japan said in a statement.
Yaohan Best is owned by Yaohan Japan and its group members, the statement said.
Yaohan Japan said the sale would take place on September 1, and added that the deal was part of a selloff of assets aimed at reducing its debts.
Yaohan Best was not immediately available for comment on the details, including the number of non-franchise outlets it has.
Best Denki said in a separate statement that the purchase of the nine shops would help it reinforce its sales network in central Japan and increase its market share in the region.
